terms.comment: Also singular, intestīnum, a gut. Ex intestīnīs labōrāre is to have trouble with one’s bowels (see bowels).
All the inner organs, heart, lungs and liver as well as the guts; in classical prose only plural (Lewis & Short).

phrases.latin: Cum decimum jam diem graviter ex intestīnīs labōrārem…
phrases.english: When I had already been suffering badly with my guts for ten days…

sources: Lewis & Short: intestinus · Lewis & Short: viscus
